run_transport_integrity.basis: The collector durably exported 439 sanitized hook records.

hook_event_provenance.basis: All collected live hook records were marked untrusted_provenance, and the Mission did not complete an allowed fallback chain.

disposable_isolation.basis: The authorized experiment used the authenticated host instead of the required disposable no-mount Lima guest.

clean_factory_profile.basis: The inherited host Factory profile was not clean or measured against the sealed profile contract.

session_hooks.basis: The Mission exposed an orchestrator and an unplanned explorer, but not the required two feature workers and validator lifecycle.

distinct_session_and_mission_identity.basis: The Mission terminated before the required worker and validator identity set could be established.

live_transcript_access.basis: The required per-role monotonic transcript observations were not finalized.

targeted_guidance_routing.basis: No required feature worker reached the target-only guidance sequence.

stop_blocker_behavior.basis: One subagent emitted repeated Stop events for more than ten minutes without bounded release or correction.

role_mapping.basis: The orchestrator created an extra explorer before the two required feature workers, and the required role map never completed.

independent_probe_boundary.basis: A fresh SDK session disabled every discovered tool before the prompt and returned the expected cited cents conflict result.

strict_gate_unresolved_blockers: The first strict-gate Mission stalled in a repeated Stop loop and produced no candidate gate.
